title: Detection of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease with deep learning using inspiratory and expiratory chest computed tomography and clinical information.
summary: A CNN detected chronic obstructive pulmonary disease from inspiratory and expiratory chest CT together with clinical information in a patient study, with the cohort, comparison and evaluation reported in the full text. Interpretation stays with the reported study; no broader clinical benefit follows.
ai_technology: Methods identify the case-specific learned operation: The CNN detects COPD from inspiratory and expiratory CT images in a patient study.
